output.answer_markdown: The Q2 2023 passages describe a spin-off that was already completed: Pfizer and Mylan spun off the Upjohn Business and combined it with Mylan to form Viatris in November 2020 [1]. Business Innovation is an operating segment established in the first quarter of 2023 that includes PC1 [2]. The passages do not describe any planned spin-off.
